inputs: ARM/inputs/inputs.json contains typed identities, weights, target, witness, source SHA256 and full-base manifest SHA256; each case has matching input.json and literal UTF-8 system.sing
variable_blocks: m blocks of27 Boolean base selectors, followed by m-2 intermediates;83 Boolean coordinates each for binary curves, one prime-field coordinate each for prime
coordinate_mapping: input.coordinate_bit_positions[j] defines the weight2^position of selectorj; binary addition is XOR, prime addition is modulo p
equations: Chained S3 constraints followed by all Boolean selector equations; original generator list retained. Intermediates in prime have no Boolean field equation.
catalog: ARM/catalog/index.json binds exact source hashes and per-case equations.jsonl with byte offsets, original expression, supports and degree histograms. Prime source stays symbolic; no invented expanded term count.
first_fall: ARM/first-fall/CASE.json carries explicit binary polynomial-combination witness or prime degree-four coefficient minor, lower-bound argument and source hash. first_fall_degree:null is unknown, not zero.
closure: ARM/closure/CASE/result.json plus operations.jsonl record exact ordinary-degree-two closure modulo Boolean field equations; raw degree bounds are preserved before reduction. LFD=2 requires a lower witness and unit or exhaustive affine-completion upper certificate.
replay: ARM/replay/*.log retains fresh-process producer verification; ARM/status/*.json records exit codes. Producer replay is not independent research review.
paired_summary: paired-summary.json has48 matched rows, identical target and witness checks, source-specific fields for both arms. Regularity and solving_degree remain null in this stage.
unknowns: null means unmeasured, unsupported or uncertified as explained by status. Never read a plateau, timeout or final basis degree as global LFD or regularity.
other_files: instruments/ contains exact executables; protocol-pdp.json, host.txt, controls, terminal.json and manifest.sha256 retain provenance and every raw artifact.
reconstruct: Extract the content-addressed paired-runs archive into a fresh directory and run sha256sum -c manifest.sha256. Source archive and publication metadata are separate immutable objects.
